title: Tools Entity
description: Defines the tool inventory for an Amadla project. Lists which tools are available and how to find them.

tools.description: List of tools registered for this project.

name.description: Tool binary name (e.g., 'hery', 'weaver', 'lay'). Used to find the binary in PATH.

path.description: Optional explicit path to the tool binary. Used when the tool is not in PATH.
